about: The status checks branch protection requires on master, per repository (read with `gh api repos/<repo>/branches/master/protection` on 2026-11-22), and what the release runs that no PR job does. scripts/check-workflow-graph.mjs fails CI when a required name is one no pull_request workflow produces; scripts/merge-blockability.mjs compares these with the live rule.

release_only_allowed.macos-agent-app: Joins the two macOS binaries into one universal app and signs and notarises it with the Developer ID secrets, which a PR (and a fork's PR) must not receive; the Release agent dry run (workflow_dispatch) exercises it end to end.
release_only_allowed.macos-agent-dmg: Notarises and staples the disk image with Apple's notary service and the release's secrets; the dry run exercises it.
release_only_allowed.linux-agent-packages: Packages the binary the release's linux-x64 leg already built and smoke-tested; unix-agents builds and gates that binary on every PR, and the dry run exercises the packaging.
release_only_allowed.windows-agent-msi: Builds the installer from the release leg's Windows binary and signs it when the Azure signing secrets exist; windows-agent builds and gates that binary on every PR, and the dry run exercises the installer.
release_only_allowed.sign-agent-release: Signs the assembled release assets with the release key; it needs every leg's artefacts, the signing tool is built and tested by validate.yml's release-sign job, and the dry run signs with a throwaway key.
release_only_allowed.publish-agent-release: Creates the GitHub release and its attestations; nothing exists to publish on a PR, and the UI's contract test holds the asset list it checks.
